title: Make the webkit-verify focus-ring probe enforcing after one green production deploy
evidence: Done: Deploy run 43456092815's verify-live printed 'focus rings verified' on iPhone 13, iPhone SE, desktop 1440 and desktop 1200, so tools/webkit-verify.mjs now runs the focus step as probeFocusRing(), which throws like the other asserts; a failure fails verify-live. advisory() had no other caller and is deleted with its two tests; tools/webkit-verify.test.ts pins the throw and the non-zero exit. Was: From PR 1627 (US-62 AC10b). tools/webkit-verify.mjs runs assertFocusRing through advisory(): it prints 'focus rings verified' or 'focus ring probe FAILED (advisory): ...' and never fails verify-live, because it has run only on the Mac and verify-live runs Linux WebKit. (H90)
